findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stations, get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, get_city_charging_stats, get_state_charging_stats, get_my_saved_stations, get_my_trips, get_my_alerts · Private data: get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, find_stations_on_route, get_charging_gaps · Public sink: get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, get_city_charging_stats, get_state_charging_stats, find_stations_on_route · Destructive: get_city_charging_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stations, get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, get_city_charging_stats, get_state_charging_stats, get_my_saved_stations, get_my_trips, get_my_alerts · Private data: get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, find_stations_on_route, get_charging_gaps · Public sink: get_nearest_stations, get_station_details, get_city_charging_stats, get_state_charging_stats, find_stations_on_route · Destructive: get_city_charging_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
